obsolete_stock_removed: Old outer bolster and high broad web aboveZ14.5, excluding fixed wall and original rod blocks. Wall upper rim and buttress tips sculpted only aboveZ30.
limitations: Nominal CAD design dimensions. Authoritative native geometry, service/motion and slicing validation are separate hash-bound release reports. No new loaded-strength qualification.

strap_mount.routing: Each end rises through its own slot, turns over the outer bar, descends outside and fastens back to itself. The free strap wraps around the object; no ribbon crosses the mechanical top or spans between eyes beneath the base in the primary route.
strap_mount.intended_bearing_contacts: Top of each outer bar at Z4 and outboard edge at Y+/-78. Positive material overlap is prohibited; face contact is intentional.
strap_mount.limitations: 25mm width and2mm single thickness are explicit design allowances, not a universal strap-fit or load-rating claim. Closure and length must suit the object; external end folds may be up to4mm thick.
